paragraphs.text: Yeva , Nature's Herald , is an elf shaman from Ravnica .

Yeva is a mysterious elf, known as the protector or herald of Ravnica's nature. She is a light-skinned elf with dark blond hair and a green dress accented with metal armor. A large bear is seen as her companion and mount. Elven shamans known as force mages are known to follow her and preach about how nature can not be stopped, in that it will rip and tear at Ravnica’s tallest buildings to claim its place in the sun.

Yeva was featured in the Nature Is Adorable Secret Lair drop as part of the 2023 Spring Superdrop where she received new art by Aya Kakeda . It also featured new flavor text mentioning that "Their favorite place in all of Ravnica was still the glade where they first met" in regards to Yeva and her bear companion.
